decided.question: does the seed grow to cover `saas` and an `access` topic for `other`, or does the coverage claim go
decided.chose: delete the coverage claim and record the two uncovered kinds as a Known Gap
decided.rejected: adding a SaaS access topic and an access-type Other row to the seed table
decided.why: an `access` topic named `Other` cannot exist beside the seeded question `Other`: REQ-02-006 makes a name unique per organization and audience, so the claim could never have been made true as the table stands, and the seed's contents are a product choice rather than a repair
decided.recordedAt: the fourth row of Known Gaps in 02-request-topics.md, which names `saas` and the `access` `other`, says why the seed is a starting catalogue rather than a migration of the old vocabulary, and gives a later revision of the seed table as what closes it

decided.question: does the catalogue ship a drag handle or up and down controls
decided.chose: up and down controls; the Settings mock is redrawn with them and the drag handle is gone
decided.rejected: the drag handle the mock drew
decided.why: rule 1 — the `@ds` barrel exports no drag or sortable primitive, so the mock asked for a component the design system cannot supply, and rule 3: a pointer-only handle is unreachable from the keyboard
decided.recordedAt: the paragraph under the Settings mock in the contracts, which states the controls, the single PATCH each issues, that the first and last rows draw one control, and that the archived list draws neither

decided.question: does PATCH …/request-topics/{topicId} refuse a supplied `type` or ignore it
decided.chose: refuse a different `type` with 400 REQUEST_TOPIC_MESSAGES.typeImmutable, and accept one equal to the stored value, exactly as the sibling `audience` behaves
decided.why: rule 2 — the same route already refuses a changed `audience` with audienceImmutable, and REQ-02-022 refuses a classifier the server owns rather than dropping it silently
decided.recordedAt: REQ-02-004, renamed 'the audience and the kind are immutable', with the rejection in its second Decided paragraph; the message row, the PATCH route errors, validation rule 3a and TC-02-INT-06 carry it

decided.question: is the `topic` response member keyed on `topicId` or on `topicLabel`
decided.chose: keyed on `topicLabel` — `topic` is null exactly when the request carries no label, and `topic.id`, `audience`, `type` and `status` are null when a labelled request carries no `topicId`
decided.rejected: keying on `topicId`, which would serve `topic: null` for a request that does carry a snapshot name
decided.why: rule 3 — the label is what the request is about and is written once; the reading that keeps showing it is the one that loses nothing, and it gives one shape to the state TC-02-INT-02 creates
decided.recordedAt: the paragraph under the `topic` member in the POST …/requests contract, and the expected result of TC-02-INT-02, which asserts that shape; the Data Model now says SetNull fires through no route rather than never in practice

decided.question: which audience gates the new-request form when it has no active topic
decided.chose: the addressee's, which is `staff` while `member` is the only addressee kind (REQ-02-020); an empty `client` audience leaves the form usable
decided.rejected: any audience, which would withdraw a working staff picker over the half of the catalogue the form cannot reach
decided.why: rule 2 — AC-16, edge case 13 and TC-02-E2E-06 all read `staff`, so the surrounding text already takes this reading
decided.recordedAt: REQ-02-017, in its rule and its second Decided paragraph
